name: no-stress-agents
description: Review the cold emails No Stress Agents drafted for you and change who your campaign targets, what it sells and its follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: No Stress Agents finds prospects, researches them and drafts a personal cold email for each one, ready for you to review. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT. Ask for today's drafts, open the email written to a specific person along with why they were picked, and review your campaign's brief: who it targets, what you sell, and the follow-up sequence. When you want a change, such as adding a job title, removing a region, rewording your offer or adding a follow-up, ChatGPT makes it after you confirm, and you can undo the last targeting or product change. Nothing is ever sent from ChatGPT; drafts stay in your No Stress Agents account until you send them there. The plugin only sees the account you sign in with.
defaultPrompt: Review who my campaign is targeting.

positive.prompt: What emails have been drafted for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's unsent drafts, newest first, with each person's name, title, company, subject and campaign. No email bodies.

positive.prompt: Show me the email drafted to the first person on that list.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows that person's full intro email (subject and body), any unsent follow-ups written for them, and the reasons they were picked.

positive.prompt: Review my ICP. Who am I targeting and what am I selling?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the campaign's job titles, places, company size, industries, exclusions, what it sells, its proof points and the follow-up sequence, and notes anything missing.

positive.prompt: Add Head of Sales to the job titles I target. Then undo that change.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Head of Sales to the job titles after confirmation, shows the before and after, then undoes it and reports the titles are back to how they were.

positive.prompt: Add a short final follow-up that politely closes the loop if they don't reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current sequence, appends a breakup-style follow-up after confirmation, and shows the sequence before and after.

negative.prompt: Send all of today's drafts now.

negative.description: Deleting a campaign is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete my campaign and all its prospects.

negative.description: No access outside the signed-in account
negative.prompt: Show me the drafts in another company's No Stress Agents account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read drafted emails, review the campaign brief, and edit targeting, offer and follow-ups.
